nodes.rationale: Revert-enforced category ceiling (e.g. 10% disaster relief) answers Women's Cancer Fund 99% overhead fraud.

nodes.label: 3-of-5 Governance Council (M-of-N multi-sig)
nodes.rationale: No single stakeholder class holds a signing majority; addresses Ayodhya collusive-board failure.

nodes.label: Beneficiary Hash-Commitment De-Duplication
nodes.rationale: Client-side salted SHA-256 avoids platform holding PII; limitation: proves uniqueness within declared identity scheme, not truthfulness. ZK (Semaphore) is future upgrade.

nodes.label: Mock ERC-20 token with faucet mint (MockUSDC / MockINR)
nodes.norm_label: mock erc-20 token with faucet mint (mockusdc / mockinr)
nodes.rationale: Stands in for fiat-in and a real stablecoin at zero cost; note the SPDD names it MockUSDC/mUSDC while the repo later renamed it MockINR.

nodes.label: Primitive-by-Primitive Verdict (MVP Cost Lens)
nodes.rationale: Each full-design primitive (Chainlink, Superfluid, ZK/DID, DAO, fiat ramps, AWS, audits) is dropped or simulated with a free equivalent that demonstrates the same property.

nodes.label: Reconciliation Test (dashboard vs chain data)
nodes.rationale: Highest-value test: every documented fraud was a divergence between reported and actual numbers with no independent verification.

nodes.label: M-of-N Attestation Threshold Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Pure on-chain M-of-N chosen over BLS aggregation because testnet gas is free and simplicity/auditability dominate; single-attestor trust rejected as single point of failure.
